founder.title: Meet Our Founder
founder.name: Shivaramakrishna M
founder.paragraph1: BharathKids was born from a simple but powerful dream—a dream where Indian children grow up not just smart in academics, but strong in values, confident in communication, disciplined in habits, and proud of their culture.
founder.paragraph2: Shivaramakrishna M deeply observed today's children and families. He noticed that children are not lacking intelligence—but they are slowly losing focus, patience, respect, confidence, and connection with real life.
founder.paragraph3: Mobile screens are replacing conversations. Marks are replacing understanding. Technology is growing faster than values.
founder.paragraph4: As an Indian and as someone who strongly believes that the future of the nation depends on the character of its children, Shivaramakrishna M felt a responsibility to act.
founder.missesTitle: BharathKids is his effort to give children what modern education often misses:
misses: The confidence to speak without fear
Respect for parents, teachers and society
Love for Indian values and culture
Wise use of technology, not addiction
